a2-unit-31.31.1 The photo task:
Tom: OK, let's practice the photo task from the TOEIC Speaking test. In the test, you have a short time to prepare, and then you speak for about thirty seconds. Here's your photo. It shows two people cooking.
Ana: OK... There are two people in this photo... There's a woman on the left... and a man on the right. They're cooking in a kitchen... The man is cutting some vegetables... and the woman is cooking something in a pan. I think they live together... or maybe they're friends. They look very happy... There's a glass of wine and some tomatoes at the bottom of the picture... and there's a window in the background. Perhaps it's the weekend... because it looks like they have a lot of time.
Tom: Great job! That was about thirty seconds.
